title: ETs tell government leaders to develop spiritually
summary: Dave Rossi tells of ETs tell government leaders to develop spiritually, about undated at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: alleged stories of ET visitation saying to our government leaders, you have to develop spiritually before we can exchange more technological information with you or or material with you.

plain: A guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, Dave Rossi, passes on stories he credits to a man named Dan Sheehan about alien visitors meeting government leaders. According to these stories, the aliens told the leaders they had to grow spiritually before more technology or material could be shared with them.
